tasks.title: Laravel model bug fix in this repo (project root), file app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeave.php: the model has NO explicit table name - line 30 is the commented-out scaffold line (double slash space protected space dollar table equals two single quotes), so Eloquent derives the table name from the class name and produces h_r_leaves (HRLeave snake pluralization splits the HR acronym). The real table in the database is hr_leaves (created by database/migrations/2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php line 30 Schema::create('hr_leaves', ...)), and every query against this model fails with SQLSTATE[42S02] Base table or view not found: 1146 Table 'ipmaerp.h_r_leaves' doesn't exist (e.g. the attendance index search for a date hits HRLeave where staff_id ... leave_status_id in (5,6) ... date_time_start/date_time_end). Fix: uncomment and set the table explicitly - replace the commented line '// protected $table = ''';' with 'protected $table = 'hr_leaves';' (keep the same indentation/tab style as the rest of the file). Do NOT change anything else in the file. Then verify with: php artisan tinker --execute="echo (new App\Models\HumanResources\HRLeave)->getTable() . PHP_EOL;" which must print hr_leaves (not h_r_leaves). Also run php -l app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeave.php. Report the exact line changed, the tinker output, and the php -l result.

Laravel migration cleanup in this repo (project root), file database/migrations/2026_08_12_175759_create_h_r_leaves_table.php: this is a leftover scaffold migration (generated by an old make:module run on a model named HRLeave) that creates an EMPTY table named h_r_leaves with only id/timestamps/softDeletes - no real columns (compare: the real table hr_leaves with all its columns is created by database/migrations/2026_08_08_100820_create_hr_leave_tables.php). The stray migration is a landmine: on any fresh migrate it would create a junk empty table with the wrong name, and it bakes in the exact naming confusion that caused the bug. VERIFY first: (1) confirm NOTHING in the codebase references the table h_r_leaves except this migration itself (grep -r h_r_leaves --include='*.php' . should match only this file); (2) confirm the migrations table does not record it as run (php artisan tinker --execute="echo DB::table('migrations')->where('migration', 'like', '%h_r_leaves%')->count() . PHP_EOL;" must print 0). If both checks pass, DELETE the file (git rm database/migrations/2026_08_12_175759_create_h_r_leaves_table.php). If either check fails, do NOT delete - report why. Report what you verified, whether the file was deleted, and the grep + tinker evidence.

Verify the HRLeave table-name fix in this repo (project root) end to end: (1) run the exact failing query shape against the live database to prove the 42S02 error is gone - php artisan tinker --execute="echo App\Models\HumanResources\HRLeave::where('staff_id', 1)->where(function ($q) { $q->whereIn('leave_status_id', [5, 6])->orWhereNull('leave_status_id'); })->whereDate('date_time_start', '<=', '2025-12-10')->whereDate('date_time_end', '>=', '2025-12-10')->count() . PHP_EOL;" (a count, not a dump - must NOT raise SQLSTATE[42S02] and should print an integer). (2) Run the full PHP test suite `php artisan test` - must stay green (baseline: 47 passed / 159 assertions, self-contained OutstationEditTest needs NO database). (3) Run `php artisan route:list --name=attendance` and confirm attendance.index resolves. Report all three results with the test report contract.

tasks.title: Document the HRLeave table-name fix in this repo (project root): write a short changelog doc to docs/changelog/2026-08-16-hrleave-table-name-fix.md describing (1) the bug: HRLeave model had no explicit $table so Eloquent derived h_r_leaves while the real table is hr_leaves, causing SQLSTATE[42S02] 1146 on the attendance date search (and any HRLeave query); (2) the fix: added protected $table = 'hr_leaves'; to app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeave.php; (3) the full-folder audit: a script compared every model's resolved table name against the live DB (SHOW TABLES) - only HRLeave was wrong (SalesAmend's derived sales_amends is correct, all others map to existing tables); (4) the stray scaffold migration database/migrations/2026_08_12_175759_create_h_r_leaves_table.php was deleted (empty h_r_leaves table, nothing referenced it, not recorded in migrations); (5) verification: tinker getTable() prints hr_leaves, the exact failing query returns a count with no 42S02, full suite green. Before writing, VERIFY each claim against the actual codebase (HRLeave has the table property set, the stray migration file is gone, the audit findings) - do not invent anything; if a claim cannot be verified, omit it or flag it as unverified. Keep it concise (roughly one screen).
